1.w: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah a Psalm. You have shown favor, O YHWH, [to] Your land; You have turned back the captivity of Jacob.

2.w: You have borne away the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sin. Selah

3.w: You have gathered up all Your fury; You have turned from the burning of Your anger.

4.w: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and Your anger toward us cause to cease!

5.w: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to generation and generation?

6.w: Will You not turn back [and] revive us, that Your people may rejoice in You?

7.w: Show us, O YHWH, Your loving devotion, and give to us Your salvation!

8.w: Let me hear what [my] God YHWH will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His holy ones; He will not let them return to folly.

9.w: Surely His salvation [is] near to those fearing Him, that glory may dwell in our land.

10.w: Loving devotion and faithfulness have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

11.w: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from the heavens.

12.w: Indeed YHWH will give that which is good, and our land will give forth its produce.

13.w: Righteousness will go before Him, to prepare the way of His steps.
